defeats.how: When Richard tried to subdue him, Shaddock caught him in a headlock and held him prisoner at gunpoint.
defeats.evidence: He tries to subdue Shaddock, only to be caught in a headlock

defeats.how: Using the darkness as cover, Peter slipped on a web-shooter, snared Shaddock's foot with a web-line to trip him, then knocked him out.
defeats.evidence: Peter quickly knocks Shaddock out, ending his threat

defeats.how: Transformed into the Ultimate Spider-Slayer, Smythe overpowered Spider-Man and subdued him with his new strength, agility and built-in web-shooters.
defeats.evidence: Smythe is able to subdue Spider-Man

defeats.how: Angered when Smythe killed the freed patient, Spider-Man broke free of his webbing and knocked him out with a few quick, powerful blows.
defeats.evidence: knock him out with a few quick, yet powerful blows
